import ThirdPartySupport from '/snippets/connectors/thirdparty.mdx'

<Warning>
  This connector is developed and maintained by Vectorworks Inc., not Speckle. For support, bug
  reports, or feature requests, contact [Vectorworks support](https://www.vectorworks.net/support)
  directly.
</Warning>

<Info>
  Compatible with Vectorworks 2026 Update 3 for Architect, Landmark, and Design Suite on macOS and
  Windows.
</Info>

## What This Connector Provides

- Publish your Vectorworks model to the Speckle web viewer to accelerate BIM collaboration workflows.
- Maintain element properties and hierarchy for coordination and analysis.
- Enable coordination with other BIM software using the Speckle open-standard data hub and connector ecosystem.
- Load model geometry from Speckle into Vectorworks as a reference while you design.

## Installation

<Steps>
  <Step title="Install the Speckle Connector">
    In Vectorworks, go to **Help** > **Install Partner Products**. Select the Speckle Connector and restart Vectorworks.
    <Frame>
    <img src="/images/third-party/Vectorworks_Install_Partner_Products.png" alt="Vectorworks Install Partner Products" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>
  <Step title="Open the Speckle Connector">
    Go to **Tools** > **Partner Products** > **Speckle** to open the Speckle Connector palette.
    <Frame>
    <img src="/images/third-party/Vectorworks_Tools_Menu.png" alt="Vectorworks Tools Menu" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>
  <Step title="Sign in to Speckle">
    Follow the prompts in the Speckle Connector palette to sign in to your Speckle account and authorize the connector.
    <Frame>
    <img src="/images/third-party/Vectorworks_Sign_In.png" alt="Vectorworks Sign In" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>
</Steps>

## Publishing a Model

<Steps>
  <Step title="Select objects">
    Select the elements you want to publish in your Vectorworks document.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Click Publish">In the Speckle Connector palette, click **Publish**.</Step>
  <Step title="Create or select a project">
    If this is your first upload, you will be prompted to create a project. For existing projects,
    select the project and specify a version number.
  </Step>
</Steps>

Geometry, object data, and metadata from your selected objects are sent to Speckle.

<Note>
  The Vectorworks connector only supports publishing selected objects. Category or view-based
  filtering is not available.
</Note>

## Loading a Model

<Steps>
  <Step title="Click Load">
    In the Speckle Connector palette, click **Load**.
    {/* Image placeholder: Speckle dialog showing Load */}
  </Step>
  <Step title="Select a project and model">
    Choose a Speckle project and the 3D model you want to load.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Use as reference">
    The loaded geometry appears in your Vectorworks document. Use it as a reference while you
    design.
  </Step>
</Steps>

## View Your Model on Speckle

To manage, view, collaborate, and coordinate your project using Speckle, go to the Speckle web viewer.
